samples.title: Overall Julep--St. Louis Style
samples.orig_snippet:
OVERALL JULEP--St. Louis Style

Use a large Mixing glass; fill with Lump Ice.



2/3 Wineglass Rye Whiskey.



2/3 Wineglass Gordon Gin.



1/2 Wineglass Import
samples.modern:
2 oz London dry gin
0.5 oz simple syrup
8–10 fresh mint leaves

Lightly press the mint and sugar in a julep cup; do not muddle to oblivion.
Add the spirit and pack the cup with crushed ice.
Stir until the cup frosts, then top with more crushed ice and a tall mint bouquet.
Serve with a short straw.

Bartender's note: julep template intact — spirit, mint, sugar, crushed ice.

samples.modern:
2 oz tawny port
2 oz hot water
1 tsp simple syrup
lemon peel

Combine wine, sugar, and hot water in a warmed mug; stir to dissolve.
Twist a lemon peel over the surface, grate fresh nutmeg on top, and serve hot.

Bartender's note: negus is a hot wine punch — port/wine base preserved.

samples.title: Egg Flip (No. 116)
samples.orig_snippet: Another way. Beat up in a jug four new-laid eggs, omitting two of the whites ; add half a dozen lumps of sugar, and rub these well in the eggs. Pour in boiling
samples.modern:
2 oz Cognac (or VSOP brandy)
0.5 oz simple syrup
1 whole egg

Dry-shake all ingredients hard for 15 seconds.
Add ice and shake again until well chilled.
Strain into a small wine glass and grate fresh nutmeg over the top.

Bartender's note: flip template — whole egg, sugar, and the original spirit preserved.
